slope_threshold_source: Forbidden = suit.json max_slope_deg (15 deg, Martian Map assumption, see its source). Caution at 10 deg: team proposal
V_source: ICES-2026-127 slide 9: 2.2 mph, maximum nominal Apollo walking speed
L_source: 104 kg suit (229 lbm max Mars suit) + 22.7 kg tools/samples (50 lbm), ICES-2026-127
eta_source: Soule & Goldman 1972: dirt road 1.1, loose sand 2.1. Mapping from roughness to eta and rough_ref = 0.5 m are our assumption
gRatio_source: Mars gravity = 3/8 g, scaling Pandolf by 0.38 is our assumption
cell_m_source: mock grid cell size, the real value comes from meta.json
P_nom_source: ICES-2026-127: 1200 BTU/hr x 0.29307 W per BTU/hr
tobler_source: Tobler 1993 hiking function (km/h). Designed for unsuited hikers, we use it only to slow down on steep slopes. Our assumption for suited Mars EVA
gcr_mSv_per_h_source: Hassler et al. 2014, Science 343: MSL/RAD average GCR dose equivalent of 0.67 mSv/day at Gale Crater (sols 1-300), divided by 24 h
gcr_assumption: RAD's 0.67 mSv/day is as per Earth day (24 h).
gcr_uncertainty_source: Hassler et al. 2014 as cited in SWSC 2016 reports 0.64 +/- 0.12 mSv/day, applied here to the 0.67 mSv/day rate as an approximation (our assumption)
